adduct_closure_projection.operator: k mol diamine + 1 mol DGEBA -> one amine-terminated adduct; the two DGEBA epoxide groups each consume one active N-H. M_adduct = k*M_amine + M_DGEBA; n_activeH_adduct = k*n_activeH_amine - 2; AHEW_adduct = M_adduct / n_activeH_adduct.
adduct_closure_projection.status: ANALYTIC_PROJECTION_ONLY -- this operator is NOT implemented as a generator production rule; it is evaluated here to quantify what capability would be required to close the measured envelope gap.

headline: Stoichiometric design-envelope coverage of the 38 deterministic-grammar hardener proposals: re-derived AHEW spans [15.025, 62.077] g/eq, while the six shipped commercial marine-epoxy hardener anchors span [100, 264] g/eq -- 0/6 anchors lie inside the generated hull and the interval overlap is 0.0000, so H0 (the grammar covers the formulation-relevant stoichiometric envelope) is REFUTED with a 37.923 g/eq shortfall to the commercial floor. Mechanism: the grammar couples molar mass to amine functionality (Spearman rho = 0.4073 between M and n_activeH over the 38), which pins AHEW = M/n_H into a narrow low band; within the dominant n_H = 4 di-primary stratum (29/38 members) the commercial floor would demand a 400 g/mol monomer, so the marginal bound max(M)/min(n_H) = 120.528 g/eq is never attained (realized frontier 62.077). Applying the published amine-DGEBA adduct closure (k mol amine : 1 mol DGEBA) analytically maps 22/38 members (k=2) into the commercial band and recovers 3/6 anchors, identifying one mass-adding, hydrogen-consuming production rule as the specific missing capability. Instrument self-tests 8/8 pass (definitional exactness plus the exact AHEW*AV = 56105.6*n_N/n_H identity), independent active-N-H re-derivation agrees with the shipped grammar column 38/38, and 6/6 non-hardener decoys fail closed.

hypothesis_evaluation.actionable_consequence: The generator's F1-F5 monomeric-diamine families are structurally incapable of reaching the amidoamine/polyamide AHEW band used by MIL-P-24441-class marine systems. The analytic adduct projection identifies one concrete missing production rule (k mol amine : 1 mol DGEBA adduct closure) that would map 22/38 of the existing universe into the commercial band without any new scaffold family.
hypothesis_evaluation.decision_rule: H0 is supported only if all six commercial AHEW anchors fall inside the generated set's AHEW hull.
hypothesis_evaluation.evidence: Generated hull [15.025, 62.077] g/eq is disjoint from the commercial envelope [100, 264] g/eq; interval overlap 0.0000; the highest-AHEW proposal (DDS-class, 62.077 g/eq) still falls 37.923 g/eq (37.92%) short of the lowest commercial anchor.
hypothesis_evaluation.h0: The deterministic-grammar hardener universe covers the stoichiometric design envelope (AHEW) spanned by the shipped commercial marine epoxy-amine hardeners.

mechanism_mass_functionality_coupling.interpretation: AHEW = M / n_activeH, so within a fixed-n_H stratum the ceiling is purely a mass ceiling. The dominant stratum is n_H = 4 (di-primary difunctional amines), where reaching the 100 g/eq commercial floor would require a monomer of 400 g/mol -- far above the grammar's realized monomeric mass ceiling. The grammar's only route to higher mass is the F1 polyethyleneamine homologation, which adds an amine site with every added unit and therefore raises n_H in step with M, leaving AHEW flat; the moderate positive rank correlation between M and n_activeH (rho = 0.4073) is that homologation showing through. Consequently the decoupled marginal bound max(M)/min(n_H) is never realized by any single production. Closing the envelope requires a production rule that adds mass while CONSUMING active hydrogens -- exactly what an amine-epoxy adduct does.

non_circularity: SMILES are read from the hash-locked prior grammar-yield receipt; molar mass, active-N-H count, basic-N count, AHEW, amine value and phr are all re-derived here from structure by RDKit. The shipped active_nh column is used only as an after-the-fact parity check and is never an input to any metric. The commercial envelope anchors originate in a different module (amphora-ingredient-library) and are independent of anything the generator produced. The AHEW*AV identity band [28052.8, 56105.6] is an exact algebraic consequence of the two instrument definitions, so it cross-checks the amine-value instrument against the AHEW instrument without any fitted parameter.
purpose: Test whether the deterministic-grammar hardener universe covers the STOICHIOMETRIC design envelope (AHEW / amine value / mix-ratio phr) of the commercial marine epoxy-amine hardeners already shipped in amphora-ingredient-library. The three prior generator receipts closed structural pillars (yield/feasibility, novelty, diversity); none tested formulation-functional coverage, which is what decides whether a proposed hardener can actually be used at 1:1 epoxide:amine-hydrogen stoichiometry.
